text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well ain't that a big haul!
You sure are somethin' else!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This is more than enough!
Thanks a ton, Trainer dude!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nah, see, watchin' your expert moves, Trainie, just got me itchin' for a one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we make a little contest out of who can grab more?
Sounds good, right!?
